result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with sidewalks but a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossings or traffic control signals for the main thoroughfare. The expansive, unmarked roadway and presence of parked vehicles along the curb create significant exposure and visibility challenges for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no designated crosswalks at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross an unmarked, wide roadway without priority.

hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable lane positioning, increasing risk during crossing.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.description: Paint center lines and edge lines to narrow the perceived travel lanes, which naturally encourages slower driving speeds.

result.summary: A residential intersection that lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps. Parked vehicles and utility poles create visual and physical obstructions for pedestrians at the crossing point.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The absence of painted crosswalks at the intersection fails to alert drivers to pedestrian crossing activity.

hazards.name: Missing Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The lack of sloped curb transitions makes the crossing inaccessible for mobility-impaired users and creates a trip hazard.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars near the corner and large trees block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility painted crosswalks to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install standardized curb ramps with tactile warning pads at all intersection corners.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.
